sentences.en: I'm very sensitive to cold. May I have another blanket?
sentences.zh: 我特别怕冷。再给我一条毯子行吗？

sentences.en: On the whole, the elite are not sensitive to criticism.
sentences.zh: 总体来说，精英阶层不太容易受到批评的影响。

sentences.en: Sharks are sensitive to electrical impulses as well as sound.
sentences.zh: 鲨鱼对电脉冲和声音也很敏感。

senses.zh: 敏感的人；有灵异能力的人
